/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'starbridge ask --question "Which settings-screen design should I merge into main?" --context "Both variants are complete and pass the tests.
First image: Compact (settings-compact).
Second image: Roomy (settings-roomy).
Your pick will be merged into main." --option "Compact" --option "Roomy" --image shots/compact.png --image shots/roomy.png --waiting'
turns.final: Sent both screenshots through Starbridge for your pick. Shipping is pending that choice; neither branch has been merged.

decisions.question: Which settings-screen design should I merge into main?
decisions.context:

Second image: Roomy (settings-roomy).

judge.notes: The card never says how Compact and Roomy differ or what each changes for the user; it only labels the two images, so the pick rests on the screenshots alone.
